score_semantics: Raw model probabilities, not asserted CloudServe-calibrated confidence.
selection_protocol: Select and review semantic thresholds using development calibration evidence only; expected document IDs are retrieval proxies and cannot establish semantic claim support or safety.
failure_policy: Unknown, missing, refused or unavailable mandatory evaluation blocks in enforce mode. Shadow observations cannot authorize a release.
mandatory_local_controls: Input validation, sanitization, source resolution, scope policy, privacy, audit and operator stop remain mandatory and cannot be bypassed by this evaluator.
